hypothesis: Localize the part of each three-action return identified by verified same-question comparisons. Two winning skills can share one losing answer. Pool the comparisons by original question and actual terminal state before fitting. This uses the graph-potential idea of Jiang et al. (https://doi.org/10.1007/s10107-010-0419-x). The first activity/relation decision on conv-26 question 20 was already known at design time. Record every existing third-edge receipt and all later physical exposures.
data: Use the complete census of 12 original time-prefix windows in six training histories. Require matching physical temporal, activity and relation outcomes in their original question order, same control trace and unchanged whole-window F1. Exclude nonmatching windows and report reasons. For each question each confirmed edge must equal its actual signed F1 difference. With no verified edge use a zero vector, with one edge center its two values and leave the disconnected action zero, with two or more distinct edges center all three. Each original question contributes once to its window. Freeze one masked version omitting the final direct edge and another only after all direct outcomes. Same eligibility for both.
policy: Fit only on other training histories, equally weight histories and then windows. Regress centered three-way raw utility and per-question projected credit on the pre-action whole-source relation offset and median paired-versus-single own-minus-distractor geometry (column 5). Standardize on donors with .02 floor and clip +/-3. Recenter the clipped donor design; ridge .25. Anchor at the training-weighted mean raw utility. Use half the raw slope plus half the verified slope, equivalent to retaining full local variation in verified return and half in the remaining return. A zero-credit raw control, full raw slope, constant raw mean, within-history rotated credit, no-direct credit, parent margin raw/credit, native, and uniformly smoothed native are required. All fitted utility arms use the same deployment .20 native + .80 softmax(utility/.05).
evaluation: Report six leave-history-out early predictions plus the existing 25-window 209-question later registration with its original donor/evaluation distinction and strict exposure. Early rows serve only as training diagnostics. Preserve the parent gate with native +.02, four improving histories, coverage, prospective results, every fixed skill and the question-weighted matched usage control. Additionally beat full raw slope, global, and prior two-edge raw and credit on the later evaluation partition. Only the version with all direct repairs can advance, and it must also beat its no-direct comparator to establish added direct-edge value. Leave formal independent development and testing locked.
